language: TypeScript 6.0.3 (test runtime); application under test language not yet selected

namingConventions.general: TypeScript: camelCase for variables/functions, PascalCase for classes; test IDs use TC_XXX_vYYY_Name format
namingConventions.files: Test scenarios: *.spec.ts under TestGeneration/tests/TestScenario/; page objects: PascalCase in Functional/; business workflows: PascalCase in Business/
namingConventions.components: Page objects extend AIPage (or AITomsPage for grid/TOMS pages); locators resolved via AIElement cache-first strategy

documentationStandard: TSDoc for TypeScript test code; application documentation convention TBD
typeStrictness: Strict TypeScript in TestGeneration/ via TestGeneration/tsconfig.json; application strictness TBD
patterns: Layered test architecture: TestScenario → Business Workflows → Functional Page Objects → SharedRuntime
Page objects extend AIPage (or AITomsPage for grid pages); locators managed via locator_cache.json and AIElement
Database support via runtime dependencies: MongoDB ^6.3, MSSQL ^10, MySQL2 ^3.6, OracleDB ^6.10, PostgreSQL ^8.11, SSH2 ^1.17
Mandatory test tags: suite, priority, type, dataImpact — all validated against TagConfiguration.json
Document public interfaces, classes, and non-trivial methods with TSDoc
conventions: Prefer consistency with existing code over personal preference
Keep functions and modules focused on a single responsibility
Use clear, descriptive names; avoid abbreviations unless they are domain-standard
constraints: Strict TypeScript (strict, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes) enforced in TestGeneration/tsconfig.json
Tests run Chromium only (Desktop Chrome device profile); single worker in both local and CI environments
Per-test timeout: 30 minutes; action timeout: 60 seconds
Application under test (AUT) stack not yet configured — run /initialize after AUT is selected

testing.mockingStrategy: Prefer explicit stubs/fakes for boundaries; use framework mocks when idiomatic
testing.enforcement: Not configured until CI is enabled
testing.ciIntegration: GitLab CI skeleton present in .gitlab-ci.yml; uses TEST_PARAMS JSON env var for execution list
testing.notes: Playwright 1.58.2 with 30-minute per-test timeout, Chromium only. Mandatory tags per test: suite, priority, type, dataImpact. Environment configured via environment-configuration-template.json with ${PLACEHOLDER} tokens; 10 cloud systems pre-configured.

projectSpecificNotes: AI-Enhanced Test Automation Framework (v1.0.0) using Playwright 1.58.2 and TypeScript 6.0.3. Layered page-object model with AIPage/AIElement base classes in SharedRuntime/. Environment configured via template JSON with ${PLACEHOLDER} tokens (10 cloud systems pre-configured). Application under test (AUT) stack not yet configured — run /initialize after AUT selection.
